name: Han Feng
source:
“I certainly wouldn’t watch. I’d close my eyes.”

The son of Mo City’s police chief, Bai Xiaoying’s boyfriend, and the friend Zhang Yuanxin can always count on to give him a hard time. He’s tall and handsome, and a good deal shyer than he looks.
